verdict.rationale: Greptile review comments include suggested code, and a one-click 'Fix with your Agent' button (plus 'Fix All') hands the issue to an external coding agent such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Devin to apply. That makes one-click application indirect: it depends on a separate agent rather than a natively committable diff on the PR. Missing for 10: evidence of native committable suggestion blocks (e.g., GitHub/GitLab 'commit suggestion') applied directly in the PR without an external agent, and independent or hands-on confirmation of the apply flow.
